text: Nationwide, the Columbus Crew front sponsor, is the Columbus-based Fortune 100 insurer whose marks are owned by Nationwide Mutual Insurance Company - a mutual, i.e. policyholder-owned rather than shareholder-owned, so there is no external owner control group and no state stake; in June 2026 it also joined the Crew's ownership group. Human-rights relevance: insurance/financial services conduct only.
